public.title: Contact us
public.metaDescription: Send us a message. Tell us your mobile number or e-mail and we will get back to you.
public.intro: Write to us about anything: a product, delivery, a custom request or just to say hello. Give us a mobile number or an e-mail so we can answer.
public.orderHelpLead: Is your question about an order you placed?
public.name: Your name
public.mobileHint: A Bangladesh number such as 01712345678. Bengali digits are fine.
public.emailHint: A mobile number or an e-mail is needed. Both is fine too.
public.subject: Subject (optional)
public.messageHint: Between 5 and 4000 characters. Plain text only, no links to pictures or code.
